definitions.gloss: balcony; outdoor platform attached to a building
definitions.explanation: Typically refers to an uncovered outdoor space projecting from a building.

examples.japanese: バルコニー⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{洗濯物|せんたくもの}→洗濯物：09533_sentakumono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{干|ほ}す→干す：00115_hosu⟧。
examples.english: I hang laundry on the balcony.

examples.japanese: バルコニー⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{花火|はなび}→花火：00087_hanabi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: You can see fireworks from the balcony.

examples.japanese: バルコニー⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{植木鉢|うえきばち}→植木鉢：06329_uekibachi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{置|お}いて→置く：01092_oku⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I keep potted plants on the balcony.

notes:
A loanword from English/Italian "balcony." Refers to an uncovered outdoor platform projecting from an upper floor of a building.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- バルコニー⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to go out onto the balcony
- バルコニー⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{干|ほ}す→干す：00115_hosu⟧: to dry laundry on the balcony
- バルコニー⟦{付|つ}き→付き：26333_tsuki⟧: with a balcony (in real estate listings)
- バルコニー⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{眺|なが}め→眺め：03502_nagame⟧: view from the balcony

バルコニー VS ⟦ベランダ→ベランダ：05072_beranda⟧:
In Japanese real estate, ⟦ベランダ→ベランダ：05072_beranda⟧ typically has a roof/covering, while バルコニー is uncovered. In everyday speech, the two terms are often used interchangeably.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦ベランダ→ベランダ：05072_beranda⟧: veranda (covered outdoor space)
- ⟦テラス→テラス：28798_terasu⟧: terrace (ground-level outdoor space)
- ⟦{屋上|おくじょう}→屋上：01341_okujou⟧: rooftop
